rule_out_raw.why: The significant weight loss of 17 pounds in 1 month is more indicative of a systemic or neoplastic process rather than a vascular disorder.

rule_out_raw.why: The finding of a lower brachial plexus deficit argues against a vascular disorder, as vascular disorders typically cause more widespread or upper limb deficits rather than isolated lower brachial plexus involvement.
